author: AEGIS Game Studios
AGSCogs
description: Plays a configured guild Soundboard sound whenever Red joins or moves voice channels, temporarily self-undeafening when required and restoring the previous self-deaf state afterwards.
end_user_data_statement: Stores only a per-guild configured Discord Soundboard sound ID. This cog stores no user data.
install_msg: Thank you for installing AGSVoiceSoundboard. Use `[p]agsvoicesoundboard list` to view this server's Soundboard sounds, then `[p]agsvoicesoundboard set <sound ID>` to select one.
short: Play a native guild Soundboard sound whenever Red joins or moves voice channels.
